checks: A no-argument launch showed the vault chooser rather than the demo; Escape/shortcuts could not bypass it, and missing/existing-folder errors preserved the chooser and existing notes.
Create vault made a fresh folder; cancelling kept its dirty buffer, and opening an existing vault saved those notes before replacing the workspace without retaining foreign buffers.
Real .NET host and interactive Blazor page opened an existing vault and imported its enabled-plugin list without rewriting it.

Core foundations exercised real file-tree creation/navigation, filtered command execution, fuzzy switching, heading navigation, live counts, and split/pin/sidebar layout restoration with no community plugins installed or enabled.

Core controls removed/restored actual commands, ribbon/view resources and keyboard access, isolated state between vaults, retained unknown configuration fields, and survived full disabled/enabled desktop process restarts. Templates, dated notes, unique collision handling and random-note empty/attachment cases ran through real UI.

Command palette settings added/reordered/removed real pinned commands and respected editor/conditional availability. Quick switcher opened a result with Ctrl+Enter, cancelled and created a missing nested note, and handled an empty vault without creating a file.
Real desktop pane, persisted homepage/search settings and a sandboxed remote page without Node or an opener
Switching tabs hides the native surface; Reading links open Web viewer and separate panes do not share website cookies
Pointer navigation, native back/forward and reload, Ctrl+F and actual find-in-page matches
New-window links stay contained; file links, vault-service navigation and redirects are blocked; no vault token reaches pages
Configured search safely encodes input; a full Electron/.NET restart restores URL, title, settings and unknown nested leaf state
Disable/enable and disabled process restart preserve unavailable leaf state, remove owned commands/ribbon and release browser contents; original workspace/settings data survive

Real source selections, edits/undo/redo and Reading mode count frontmatter only when selected, use reference numeric/punctuation/CJK/kana/Korean/Tamil/Tibetan rules and UTF-16 emoji/CRLF lengths without writing the note.

Outline uses actual ATX/Setext metadata, excludes YAML/comments/indented and nested-length fences, nests skipped levels correctly, folds by pointer/keyboard/all controls and follows real source-cursor navigation.
inputEnvironment: Windows occlusion and renderer/timer background throttling disabled in disposable UI processes, including restarts; production launch is unchanged.
